boundary_refine._comment: Read by asr_mcp/speaker/boundary.py (the single boundary engine). Rollback: acoustic:false (energy-only, method 1+2 off) and spectral_novelty:false (reproduces the pre-P1 numbers exactly). enabled:false closes every boundary at the gap midpoint. spectral_min_ratio / spectral_min_abs are UNCALIBRATED conservative defaults - they are the knobs the P0 A/B should move, not measured values.

learning._comment: A diarization cluster is not a person. Before an unknown cluster is learned as a PENDING profile its segments are embedded individually and re-clustered at max_intra_cluster_dist, so a cluster holding two voices yields two profiles instead of one poisoned profile. 0.32 comes from one real 2-host podcast (ZO249) with inserted clips: within-group span distances 0.175-0.291, between-group 0.368-0.448. It is a judgement call on a single file, so split_clusters:false is the rollback. PHASE P2 added: fail_closed (true = a blend or an unverifiable split means DO NOT LEARN; false = the old fail-open behaviour), max_profile_intra_dist and min_inter_dist (the per-group purity gate), extend_max_dist (extend a pending profile by VOICE, not by source filename), max_snippet_sec / max_profile_total_sec (0 = unlimited) and max_refine_weight_ratio (one snippet weighs at most this many MEDIAN snippets). All four new distances reuse the single 0.32 measurement; none is calibrated.

live_attribution._comment: Live (WebSocket) turn attribution. A mic turn is labelled from its input device and never embedding-matched against its own user's voiceprint. min_match_confidence is 0.60 because an END-TO-END run measured a REAL false positive at conf 0.539: a 5s turn of an UNREGISTERED speaker was named as a registered one. The earlier value of 0.15 was calibrated against a negative population of CORRUPTED AUDIO (combined 0.78-0.87), which never measured the band a different-but-similar colleague actually occupies. A false name is worse than no name, so this stays conservative: live per-turn naming is a bonus, and the authoritative attribution is the client's shutdown re-diarization of the whole recording, which has minutes of context instead of one turn.
